shortDescription: A ~2.5-hour Greek mythology puzzle and combat adventure built in Godot 4.7 & GDScript, featuring a five-floor campaign, boss fights, 100+ voiced lines with word-level subtitle sync, and four branching endings.
fullSummary: Built in under a month on a $0 budget as a two-person indie game project, The Evils is a puzzle/combat adventure inspired by Greek mythology. You play as Gale, a university professor having a particularly unfortunate day who must descend into Pandora's Box to confront the spirits unleashed upon the world. Combining handmade and AI-generated assets in Godot 4.7 and GDScript, the game delivers roughly 2.5 hours of gameplay across five floors with four possible endings driven by player choices. Available now as a playable Windows beta build (unsigned executable, so Windows SmartScreen may show a standard warning on first launch).
highlights: Five-Floor Branching Campaign: Structured progression with checkpoints and four distinct endings determined by player choices across an average ~2.5-hour playthrough.
Mythology-Driven Boss Fights & Puzzles: Multiple boss encounters and puzzle/combat sequences tied directly into the Pandora's Box narrative.
100+ Voiced Lines & Word-Level Subtitle Sync: Over a hundred fully voiced dialogue lines paired with custom word-level audio synchronization for subtitles.
Custom Character Rigging & Pose Systems: Built custom rigging and pose workflows to drive character animations and movement.
Godot 4.7 Performance Optimization: Iteratively profiled and tuned rendering, environments, asset loading, and scene management throughout development.
